label: Cash & banks
explanation: Money in checking, savings, and cash on hand — what you could spend today.

label: Money customers owe us
explanation: Invoices you've sent that customers haven't paid yet.

label: Other current assets
explanation: Short-term stuff you own that isn't cash or unpaid invoices, like deposits or prepaid expenses.

label: Equipment & property
explanation: Big things you own and use for years — trucks, tools, machines, buildings.

label: Accumulated depreciation
explanation: The wear-and-tear already counted against your equipment's original cost.

label: Bills we owe
explanation: Bills from vendors and suppliers you haven't paid yet.

label: Credit cards
explanation: Balances owed on business credit cards.

label: Taxes owed
explanation: Payroll, sales, and other taxes you've collected or accrued but haven't sent in yet.

label: Other current liabilities
explanation: Other short-term amounts you owe that aren't bills, credit cards, or taxes.

label: Loans & long-term debt
explanation: Money borrowed that gets paid back over more than a year — bank loans, vehicle notes, lines of credit.

label: Owner draws — money the owner takes out
explanation: Money the owner takes out of the business for personal use.

label: Owner equity
explanation: The owner's stake in the business — what's left after subtracting everything owed from everything owned.

label: Revenue
explanation: Money earned from selling your products or services.

label: Other income
explanation: Money that comes in from outside your normal work, like interest earned or rebates.

label: Direct labor — wages for people doing the billable work
explanation: Wages for the people doing the billable work, like field crews and technicians.

label: Subcontractors
explanation: Payments to outside companies or people you hire to do parts of the job.

label: Materials & direct costs
explanation: Materials, parts, and other costs that go directly into the jobs you do.

label: Office & admin payroll
explanation: Wages for office and administrative staff who keep the business running.

label: Insurance
explanation: Business insurance costs — liability, workers comp, vehicles, and similar coverage.

label: Rent & facilities
explanation: Rent, utilities, and other costs of the space your business operates from.

label: Other overhead
explanation: General running costs that don't tie to a specific job — software, phones, fees, supplies.

label: Tax expense
explanation: Taxes the business pays as an expense, like payroll taxes or business income taxes.

label: Interest expense
explanation: The cost of borrowing money — interest paid on loans and credit lines.

label: Depreciation (non-cash)
explanation: An accounting charge that spreads equipment cost over its life — no cash actually leaves.

label: Underbillings
explanation: Work you've completed but haven't billed the customer for yet.

label: Overbillings
explanation: Amounts you've billed customers ahead of the work actually done.

label: Retention receivable
explanation: The portion of your invoices a customer holds back until the job is finished.
